_notes: Terminology unified per glossary (one term per concept): consultation = परामर्श (काउन्सेलिङ dropped); plan = प्लान everywhere (mobile:plan.*/more.* used योजना, which collides with अध्ययन योजना = study plan); matches = मिल्ने कार्यक्रम / मिल्ने विश्वविद्यालय (म्याच reads as a sports match in Nepali); document review = कागजात समीक्षा; 'checked' = जाँच, 'verified' = प्रमाणित (reserved for official verification); team = टोली (टिम dropped); apostille = एपोस्टिल (one key had अपोस्टिल); GPA kept Latin (जीपीए dropped); sign up = साइन अप (दर्ता dropped so it pairs with साइन इन).
Student-facing 'परामर्शदाता/सल्लाहकार/समीक्षक' (counselor) replaced by Hangyul टोली / Hangyul Univ टोली following the English; staff-facing mobile:university.* / mobile:v3.uni.* keep परामर्शदाता.

Personal statement rendered as पर्सनल स्टेटमेन्ट (the term Nepali applicants actually use; no established native term) and study plan as अध्ययन योजना; 'स्टडी प्लान एडिटिङ' dropped. Owner may prefer a native coinage for personal statement.
Standard admission letter = मानक भर्ना पत्र; the English name is added in parentheses once, in mobile:v3.offer.step.letter, because the student will meet it in English on the visa paperwork.

Consular legalization = कन्सुलर प्रमाणीकरण (मानार्थ: embassy/consulate authentication); plain प्रमाणीकरण was ambiguous with 'verification' in mobile:v3.docAction.LEGALIZE, v3.university.documentsCount, v4.application.nextLegalize, v3.reviews.legalization.

student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary (and mobile twin) dropped 'transfer details, timing, retention period' which the Korean-derived Nepali carried but the reviewed English does not; label now says the email/number are processed abroad to verify them, not 'identity verification'.
mobile:login.networkError: dropped the Android-emulator / LAN-IP developer hint, matching the English customer meaning.
mobile:plan.chooseLede: 'एक पटकको भुक्तानीले पूरै प्रक्रिया समेट्छ' (one payment covers the whole process) overpromised for Basic; now mirrors the English.
mobile:v3.profile.unlock.sponsor: 'तयार गर्छ' claimed we prepare the visa financial documents; now says the student can prepare them early (as in the English).
student:onboarding.goals.degreeSub.LANGUAGE: dropped the added marketing clause 'धेरैले रोज्ने सजिलो सुरुवात' not present in the English.
Greetings: 'Good afternoon' kept as नमस्ते (no natural Nepali afternoon greeting); 'High school' unified as उच्च माध्यमिक (+2) across onboarding and register.prior.
Digit style is mixed across the file (Devanagari ७/१० vs ASCII 7/10, usually ASCII next to units like MB). Left as is; owner may want one rule.
mobile:v3.reviews.summary / att.breached use वाचा (promise) for the SLA 'promise' — kept, it is the agency vocabulary.
